-->}}</includeonly><noinclude>For use on {[[Template:Summarylink|{SummaryLink}]]}

Normalizes 'prologue', 'epilogue' and 'glossary', and leaves everything else.

===Examples===
*<nowiki>{{C1|PblAh}} → Prologue</nowiki>
*<nowiki>{{C1|10}} → 10</nowiki>
*<nowiki>{{C1|DbLaH}} → Dblah</nowiki> (eg Ravens would get lc'd and then ucfirst'd)
